claims.statement: In 1970 Warren replaced a speech sound with cough/tone
claims.limits: Experiment abstract; no exact sentence or invented sample

claims.statement: Listeners experienced the missing sound despite physical replacement
claims.limits: Qualitative result; no prevalence invented

claims.statement: Silence makes gap location clearer than noise replacement
claims.limits: Relative demonstration, not universal

claims.statement: 1971 work tested influence of earlier and later linguistic context
claims.limits: No invented sample/effect size

claims.statement: Samuel found restoration varied with class and acoustics of replacement
claims.limits: Noise / tone / brief silence distinctions in original abstract

claims.statement: Repp's initial two tests weakly favored auditory induction with potential context confounding; last three better-controlled experiments did not
claims.limits: Publisher abstract; bounded to fricative/noise and experiment stimuli; not a universal null result

claims.statement: 2024 systematic review included 31 music/noise/binaural-beat studies
claims.limits: Not a Zen12 intervention study

claims.statement: Review concluded arousal-cognition relation mixed/insufficient
claims.limits: Does not prove Zen12 efficacy or inefficacy

claims.statement: Inspire3 catalog lists Zen12, Hypnosis Live and Brainwave Shots
claims.limits: Does not establish FV account approval

claims.statement: Zen12 Premium publicly lists 12 levels and 48 MP3 tracks
claims.limits: Delivery unverified

claims.statement: Zen12 publicly lists guided, nature, music and white noise styles
claims.limits: Do not infer outcomes

claims.statement: Zen12 currently publicly advertises a one-year money-back guarantee
claims.limits: Actual fulfillment and checkout terms unverified

claims.statement: Zen12 page displays $87.99 promotional Premium offer on 2026-11-08
claims.limits: No final total/taxes/currency/eligibility verified; NOT quoted in live copy

claims.statement: Zen12 12-minutes-equals-one-hour-advanced-meditation assertion
claims.limits: Do not present as fact; non-product-specific studies insufficient

claims.statement: Zen12 treats anxiety or cures attentional deafness
claims.limits: No product-specific substantiation supplied

claims.statement: Exact Hypnosis Live Total Focus publicly states 33min/47MB
claims.limits: Different product; no cross-promotional substitution

claims.statement: Hypnosis Live Total Focus 14-day seller refund promise and FAQ restrictions
claims.limits: Not independently tested; no unconditional risk-free claim

claims.statement: FTC disclosure material connections clearly near earning recommendations
claims.limits: Disclosures contextual, not a blanket safe harbor

claims.statement: Health/benefit advertising claims require appropriate substantiation
claims.limits: Even implied efficacy cannot inherit unrelated experiment

claims.statement: Existing Fieldbook uses one existing signup route
claims.limits: Confirmation/individual newsletter delivery not proven

claims.statement: Puységur archival source is historical context not clinical evidence
claims.limits: Do not apply historical reports as product claims

claims.statement: There is named FV Inspire3 approval and account earning link
claims.limits: No named approval found in targeted Gmail; private dashboard not accessed

claims.statement: There is an authenticated paid FV-owned Mind Payhip SKU
claims.limits: No authenticated SKU/checkout/rights/returns; do not substitute invented product

claims.statement: R220 article is public and approved for Grok media
claims.limits: Source-only no live slug; do not post

claims.statement: Affiliate click is independently verified paid sale
claims.limits: Merchant-confirmed settled/cleared conversion required

claims.statement: Balota & Black 1997 reported four experiments; young/old semantic task differences
claims.limits: The first two experiments did not yield the same old-adult pattern

claims.statement: Balota & Black's third rhyme and fourth unrelated-prime controls were negative
claims.limits: Disfavors generic task fatigue alone; not no-effect-in-all-tasks

claims.statement: Pilotti 1997 same-speaker repetitions versus multiple voices differed
claims.limits: Authors favor acoustic adaptation; attention strategy alternative

claims.statement: Pilotti 2004 2/15/30 repetitions under auditory and AV conditions
claims.limits: Different modality and designs from Balota; abstract reviewed

claims.statement: 2017 EEG study analyzed 25 people after one artifact exclusion
claims.limits: Young Swedish speakers; not all populations

claims.statement: 2017 experiment measured reduced N400 semantic relatedness response at 30 vs 3 repetitions
claims.limits: Source localization exploratory; not a product trial

claims.statement: 2024 study proposed bottom-up mechanisms using deep learning models
claims.limits: Simulation is not human trial, not Zen12 validation

claims.statement: Repeat-a-word exercise in investigation is informal observation
claims.limits: No randomized trials, timed decisions or EEG

claims.statement: Zen12 product-specific 12 minutes equals one hour of advanced meditation
claims.limits: Do not present equivalence as fact

claims.statement: Zen12 Premium displayed $87.99 public promo on November 8, not verified checkout
claims.limits: Price changes; no authenticated purchase/fees

claims.statement: No authenticated named FV Inspire3 approval, channel permission, URL or settlement
claims.limits: Gmail general promotional mail does not establish acceptance

claims.statement: Actual confirmed paid orders or cleared commissions from this candidate
claims.limits: Do not turn click or lead into purchase

claims.statement: Original R210 A/B experiment remains frozen and the 42s video unrendered
claims.limits: R221 alternate copy candidates are not assigned or tested

claims.statement: Shared profile YouTube link does not prove specific Shorts asset attribution
claims.limits: Use channel_profile only after approval, not fictitious asset ID
